en: A colored vintage postcard showing a general view of a busy harbour with several steamships and sailing vessels anchored near long quays. On the left is a low shoreline with buildings and a tall minaret-like tower in the distance. Calm blue water fills most of the image, with mooring posts and small boats visible. The title at the top reads 'PORT-SAID — General view of the Harbour', and there is a website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' across the lower right.
